snippet.title: TennoCon 2025 | The Old Peace | Full 23-minute Gameplay Demo
snippet.description:
Our sprawling cinematic narrative will soon turn to the spectacular history of a forgotten period of unity between Sentients and The Orokin. Witness this lost chapter in the major 2025 update: The Old Peace.

Our full gameplay demo recorded live from the main stage at TennoCon 2025 joins Community Director Megan Everett and Creative Director Reb Ford on a harrowing trip down memory lane to a fragile period of peace between the Orokin and Sentients during their preeminent conflict in the Tau System. Navigating long-forgotten memories with an enhanced Operator, watch them enter a brutal theater of trench combat against the Dax Anarchs alongside a different kind of Grineer, as well as a new Sentient friend, Adis.

Featuring a moving musical track, a special appearance by Caliban Prime (coming soon), the Tauron Focus Expansion and a Quest-limited appearance by Excalibur Prime, The Old Peace will also introduce new Sentient enemies and allies, the devilish Warframe, Uriel, plus two never-before-seen Protoframes — all while setting the stage for a transformative Tau update moving beyond the Origin System in 2026.

Learn more at https://www.warframe.com/the-old-peace and be sure to tune into our Devstreams this fall at https://www.twitce.tv/warframe for further details.
